title: Indoor opening size and location.
officialText: Openings used to connect indoor spaces shall be sized and located in accordance with Sections 304.5.3.1 and 304.5.3.2 (see Figure 304.5.3). ALL AIR FROM INSIDE THE BUILDING (see Section 304.5.3)
